cases.title: Explore a four-view scene
cases.prompt: Move through the room toward the open passage.
cases.description: An authored VLNVerse scene with synchronized cameras, recorded history and same-pose occupancy.
cases.provenance: Paired simulation illustration: native four-camera RGB, rendered semantic IDs and metric depth, with same-scene mesh occupancy. Display readouts are illustrations, not measured model predictions.
cases.motionSource: Recorded 30 Hz poses; each frame uses the causal 0.6-second history ending at that frame.
cases.coordinateFrame: per-frame robot body: x forward, y left, z up

source.occupancy: same authored scene, cropped in each frame body coordinates

frames.occupancyProvenance: Same-scene meshes revoxelized at this frame pose; separately audited display transform; source volume retained.

cases.title: Navigate to a point goal
cases.prompt: Reach the supplied waypoint (7.04, 5.95) m in the current robot frame.
cases.description: A supplied four-camera PointGoal recording with paired occupancy and recorded robot history.
cases.coordinateFrame: per-frame robot body: x forward, y left, z up

source.samplingEvidence: All consecutive world translations equal rotation(yaw) @ action_xy * 0.2; maximum residual 3.31e-7m. Preview video is encoded at10fps (2x playback).

cases.provenance: Paired recorded RGB, occupancy and robot history; semantic/depth displays are declared illustrations, not model predictions or source ground truth.

frames.depthProvenance: Raycast of the same-step supplied occupancy using recorded intrinsics; assumed camera height0.8m, zero mount offset and pitch, four cardinal yaw offsets. Ground plane assumed atz0. No source depth GT. CLS/latent displays use16/12-cell low-pass respectively.

cases.title: Follow the person in red
cases.prompt: Follow the person wearing a red shirt.
cases.description: Four synchronized views from the supplied tracking recording.

source.targetDescription: The person wearing a red shirt.
source.geometryStatus: No paired scene geometry, metric depth, or camera poses supplied with this clip.

cases.provenance: Unannotated RGB extracted from the user-supplied four-view clip. Frames are video-frame indices; physical simulation step duration and camera headings are unknown. Target boxes are manually reviewed display overlays; semantic and latent readouts are illustrations. No paired metric depth, occupancy, or robot/target poses are supplied.
